theme_and_vibe.description: A highly professional, administrative compliance SaaS dashboard for a veterinary complementary medicine association. It must feel trustworthy, grounded, and clear. Avoid generic Vercel/Stripe tech vibes. Use organic colors, solid structural grayscale, and tactile surfaces.

rules.headings: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 24px. Use Work Sans in medium to semi-bold weights for clear administrative hierarchy.
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility in data-dense tables and forms. tracking-normal, leading-relaxed.
rules.labels: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-widest) for overlines and form labels.

primary.description: Deep Forest Green for primary actions and brand elements.

secondary.description: Sage Green for secondary actions and subtle highlights.

accent.description: Terracotta for notifications, action-required elements, and warnings.

dashboard_grid.type: High Density Grid (Bento Protocol Mode B)
structure: Top Level (col-span-full): 'Wat moet ik nog doen?' (What do I still need to do?) call-to-action banner. Use a soft background (e.g., neutral-100) with a prominent Terracotta action button if tasks are pending.
Middle Level (col-span-1 md:col-span-2): Progress tracking widgets. Circular progress rings for 'Bijscholingspunten' (6/8) and 'Consulten' (34/40).
Middle Level (col-span-1 md:col-span-2): Deadlines / Calendar countdown ('Dagen tot deadline').
Bottom Level (col-span-full): Recent activity list (Recente registraties) showing status badges.
Top Level: Quick metric cards (col-span-1) for 'Bijscholingen ter beoordeling', 'Jaarformulieren ter controle', 'Leden met achterstand'.
Main Level: Dense data tables using standard shadcn/ui table components with clear status badges and inline 'Beoordelen' (Review) actions.

surfaces.cards: Cardless or max 8px border-radius. Use flat backgrounds with 1px border-neutral-200. No heavy drop shadows. Keep it tactile (Neumorphism mixed with flat design - soft ambient shadow shadow-sm, 1px border to ground it).
surfaces.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border. Do NOT use transparent headers over content.

components_and_features.forms: Use Shadcn/UI inputs, selects, and textareas. Use tight vertical spacing for dense administrative input. Labels must be clear Dutch terminology.
components_and_features.document_upload: Drag-and-drop zone with dashed borders. Show file name and size upon upload.
components_and_features.progress_indicators: Use SVG-based circular progress rings for continuing education points (bijscholingspunten) and consults.
components_and_features.annual_overview_pdf: A visually distinct section that previews the 'Jaaroverzicht' (Annual Overview) looking like an official document (white background, serif headers for print feel, strict grid) before the user clicks 'Indienen' (Submit).
components_and_features.audit_trail: A vertical timeline component showing history of a registration (e.g., Ingediend -> In beoordeling -> Aanpassing gevraagd).

vet_examining_dog.description: Veterinarian examines a dachshund. Use for the login/auth screen background or onboarding hero.

male_vet_avatar.description: Professional male vet portrait. Use as the default logged-in member avatar.

female_vet_avatar.description: Professional female vet portrait. Use for admin avatar.

icons.instruction: Use clean, consistent line icons. For the member dashboard, emphasize action icons like CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, FileText, Upload.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements (buttons, table rows) must have subtle background color transitions. e.g., hover:bg-neutral-100.
motion.lists: Stagger entrance animations for admin queue items using Framer Motion.
motion.progress_rings: Animate the stroke-dashoffset of progress rings on mount to visually 'fill up' to the user's current points/consults.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate `.js` and `.jsx` files, NOT `.tsx`. Do not use TypeScript syntax.
All labels and text must be in Dutch (e.g., 'Bijscholingen', 'Consulten', 'Jaarformulier', 'Beoordelen', 'Indienen').
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="submit-jaarformulier-button"`).
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use left-aligned dense grids for professional administrative systems.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Ensure solid contrast.
Use 2-3x more generous spacing (p-6, p-8) around forms and structural containers to avoid a cramped CRUD look.
Never use `transition: all`. Specify exact properties (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
Avoid the standard 'SaaS Blue'. Use the specified Forest Green / Sage palette for a veterinary/natural medicine vibe.
Ensure 'What do I need to do?' is always the most prominent visual element on the Member dashboard.
